shell_commands: npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/types/session.ts CHANGELOG.md
git add CHANGELOG.md src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/session.ts

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
transport: handle list_sessions frames and serialize conversation lists

- Thread sessionStore into createMessageHandler to enable list_sessions handling
- Implement handleListSessions to call store.listFor and serialize dates as ISO strings
- Add UNSUPPORTED error code for when history feature is disabled or store lacks listFor
- Fix typecheck error in validation by properly typing Record construction
- Add changelog entry documenting WebSocket conversation list feature

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status

git add src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && git commit -m "transport: return empty session list when store has no listFor

Match acceptance test expectations by returning empty session list instead
of error when sessionStore.listFor is not implemented. Allows graceful
handling of stores that don't support listing conversations.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push origin HEAD && git status
git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "dod: mark handler implementation facet as complete"
git push origin HEAD && git status
